articles.title: Houthi Terrorist Attack on Riyadh Financial District Tower Causes Material Damage
articles.description: The General Directorate of Civil Defense stated that on Thursday, November 19, 2026, civil defense teams responded to an incident in which one of the towers in Riyadh’s financial district was targeted in a terrorist attack by the terrorist Houthi militia, SPA reported. The attack resulted in material damage to several floors of the tower and neighboring buildings, with no injuries reported.
